chapter: Returning to the US and the Savoy band
title: Forming the band for the Savoy Ballroom
summary: He toured for a couple of months before the Savoy, with Tyree Glenn and Eddie Heywood in the group.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Then do you recall when you formed your band, which ultimately went in to the Savoy? Was that before you went in, or did you get the possibility of going to the Savoy first and then form a band? How did that work?

I got the band together sometime before going to the Savoy. I remember, because I did a road tour before then. I don't even remember, just, you know, the places I played, but I know that I went out on the road with the band. Oh, probably for a couple of months before I went in to the Savoy.
Was this more or less the same group that you took in to the Savoy?
It could very well have been, or the band that I took in to the Savoy probably contained some of the same members.
Uh huh. For example, you had in the Savoy, I think that was the group with Tyree Glenn?
Oh yes. With Tyree Glenn joining the band during the time that we were at the Savoy, so he wouldn't have been with us before that.
At the Savoy, yes. Eddie Haywood, who was on piano at the time.
Eddie Haywood might have been with us before, because he was in the Savoy with us all the time. I don't remember having any other pianist.
Right. Going in to the Savoy, then,
was a kind of a -- this was a kind of big event, wasn't it?
Yes, it was someplace to set the band down and you know, to play every night, and kind of get the whole thing to jell.
